about: JARVIS-DFT crystals whose band gap has been MEASURED (the JARVIS-Leaderboard experimental band-gap benchmark). They are left out of training, validation and test of the TBmBJ band-gap task (mbj_bandgap, DEC-022), so that its models can later be scored against measured gaps on crystals they never saw. Only the identifiers are stored here; the measured values stay at the source.
